rationale: The 'Overall' row of tables/tables/Table4.tex reports %ΔW = 0.068 (0.010), %ΔW_No spillover = 0.041 (0.009), and the spillover share (%ΔW - %ΔW_No spillover)/%ΔW = 0.397*** (std. err. 0.119). This exactly reproduces the paper's reported 0.397 (std. err. 11.9%) for the spillover share of the overall wage increase. The replicated value 0.397 equals the paper value 0.397 (0% relative error, well within ±1σ = 0.119), so the claim is a match. The consistency check (0.068 - 0.041)/0.068 = 0.397 also holds internally.
